                ),
            )
        else:
            resolve_margin = Size(0, 0)

        box_models = resolve_box_models(
            [styles.width for styles in child_styles],
            children,
            size,
            viewport,
            resolve_margin,
            resolve_dimension="width",
            greedy=greedy,

            children, box_models, margins
